div.div: حِرِىٌّ , and (if you will, S) ↓ حِرَحِىٌّ , (S, K,) in which latter the medial radical letter is with fet-h, as in the rel. ns. formed from يَدُ and غَدٌ, namely, يَدَوِىٌّ and غَدَوِىٌّ; (S;) [Of, or belonging to, or relating to, the vulva, or pudendum, of a woman;] rel. ns. of حِرٌ [and حِرْحٌ]: and (if you will, S) you may say ↓ حَرِحٌ , like سَتِةٌ. (S, K.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
